Leadership inspection file

Source: R/inspect-leadership.R
leadership_inspection.Rd

A tidy, one-row-per-person table for checking by hand how Part VII names are matched across a merger. For each sampled case it lists:

Usage

leadership_inspection(
  merger_data,
  n = 100L,
  types = c("merger2", "mergerN", "consolidation"),
  pre = -2:0,
  post = 1:2,
  seed = 1L,
  file = NULL
)

Arguments

merger_data

The list from build_merger_data() (uses part7, and leadership, donors, recipients when present), or a project from merger_project().

n

Number of cases to sample.

types

Merger types to sample from.

pre, post

Event years for the rosters before and after the merger.

seed

Random seed for the sample.

file

CSV path to write, or NULL to only return the table.

Value

A data.table, invisibly when file is given: MERGER_ID, TYPE, RETENTION (group), SHARE_A_RETAINED, CEO_CAT, BOARD_CAT, CASE, ORG_EIN2, ORG_NAME, PERSON_KEY, NAME, TITLE, PAY (compensation from the organization), HOURS, POSITION, PERIODS, and flags IN_ORG_A, IN_ORG_B, IN_MERGED, RETAINED_FROM_A (in ORG A and in MERGED), MATCH_BASIS (for people on both the donor's and the recipient's rosters, why the names matched; see name_match_basis()), and GOVERNING (trustee or officer, or a 990-EZ listing).

Details

  • ORG A: everyone on the donor's Part VII in the pre years;

  • ORG B: everyone on the recipient's Part VII in the pre years;

  • MERGED: everyone on the recipient's Part VII in the post years.

A person is one name key (name_keys(), the key the matching uses), so the file shows exactly what the matcher treats as the same person. When a person's name, title, pay, or hours differ across years, the values are joined with ;;, each followed by the years it applies to, for example PRESIDENT {t=-2,-1};; CEO {t=0}.

Cases are drawn in equal numbers from three groups by the share of ORG A people who appear in MERGED: none (0), some (above 0 and below 0.5), and most (0.5 or more). Only cases with an ORG A roster and a MERGED roster are eligible.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
proj <- merger_project( "~/Documents/NPMERGER" )

leadership_inspection(
  merger_data = proj,
  n           = 100,
  file        = file.path( proj$root, "leadership-inspection.csv" )
)
} # }
